name: Solo4Players
noteEs: Solo4Players cubre Cyberpunk 2077 en español con foco en builds y guías de mecánicas. Es uno de los pocos creators hispanohablantes que mantienen cobertura consistente del juego después del 2.0, con builds específicas por arquetipo (Ninja Assassin, Tech, Netrunner) y guías de crafting actualizadas a cada patch. Audio claro, ediciones limpias, contenido sin filler — ideal para audiencia hispana que prefiere consumir guías en su idioma sin perder calidad técnica.
noteEn: Solo4Players covers Cyberpunk 2077 in Spanish with a focus on builds and mechanics guides. He's one of the few Spanish-speaking creators maintaining consistent coverage of the game post-2.0, with archetype-specific builds (Ninja Assassin, Tech, Netrunner) and crafting guides updated to each patch. Clear audio, clean edits, no filler — ideal for Spanish-speaking audiences who prefer to consume guides in their language without losing technical quality.
highlightsEs: Builds detalladas por arquetipo actualizadas a cada patch (2.21, 2.3) con perks, atributos y cyberware específicos
Guía definitiva de crafting de Cyberpunk 2077 — referencia para la audiencia hispana
Cobertura de mecánicas que cambian entre patches con explicación accesible
Series de 'guía de inicio' para players nuevos que arrancan post-2.0
highlightsEn: Detailed archetype builds updated to each patch (2.21, 2.3) with specific perks, attributes, and cyberware
Cyberpunk 2077 definitive crafting guide — reference for the Spanish-speaking audience
Coverage of mechanics that change between patches with accessible explanation
'Getting started' series for new players starting post-2.0
